plugins.name: beacon
plugins.description: Conversational companion for beacon-docs (v0.2.0 — 6 skills shipped). Always-available `beacon-workflow` nudges Claude to create the right Beacon documents at the right conversational moments; five invocable slash-skills (`/beacon:beacon-init`, `/beacon:beacon-new`, `/beacon:beacon-doctor`, `/beacon:beacon-explain`, `/beacon:beacon-archive`) wrap the CLI for explicit operations.
